"\"Act as an expert HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript game developer. Build a complete, playable 2D top-down tactical mech shooter in a single HTML file (combining HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript) called 'Titan Grid: Tactical Arena'.
1. Pre-Match Squad Hangar (Loadout Menu):
Before spawning, let the player customize their Hangar by picking one of 5 Distinct Mechs (each with unique HP, Speed, Energy Capacity, and a Signature Cooldown Ability):
Aegis-V (Bastion Class): Medium speed, deploys a Hardlight Chrono-Wall—a wide energy barrier that freezes and blocks incoming enemy projectiles while allowing allied shots to pass through.
Volt-Strider (Interceptor Class): High speed, triggers Tempest Blitz—a hyper-velocity forward rocket dash that releases an electro-magnetic shockwave on impact, disabling enemy movement and weapons for 2.5 seconds.
Wraith-9 (Phantom Class): Fast speed, activates Void Shroud—shifts into a cloaked spectral state, breaking all AI target locks, boosting movement speed by 30%, and cleansing negative status effects.
Colossus-X (Dreadnought Class): Massive HP, slow speed, triggers Overdrive Core—emits a golden command pulse that boosts weapon damage by 50% for itself and any nearby allied mechs.
Valkyrie-7 (Artillery Skirmisher): Balanced chassis, launches Swarm Barrage—fires a salvo of autonomous micro-missiles from shoulder pods that curve around obstacles to strike the nearest locked enemy.
2. Dual-Weapon Mounting System:
Let the player equip a weapon pair (Left Mount @COMMENT_BODY@ Right Mount) from 4 original weapon archetypes:
Tesla Coil-X: Continuous close-range plasma arc that chains lightning between closely grouped enemies.
Singularity Ray: Sustained medium-range beam that stacks unstable dark-matter charges on a target, triggering a high-damage gravity burst once the meter fills.
Hellfire Scattergun: Close-quarters thermal shotgun that fires a cone of incendiary slag, dealing burst damage and applying a damage-over-time melt effect.
Spiker Pod Launcher: Mid-to-long range rapid launcher that fires crystallized explosive spikes which stick to targets or walls and detonate after 1.5 seconds.
3. 5v5 Control Point Clash @COMMENT_BODY@ Arena Map:
Map Design: Symmetrical sci-fi arena with solid cover blocks, flank lanes, and 3 Central Control Beacons (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) that glow cyan when captured by allies and crimson when captured by enemies.
AI Bots: 4 Allied AI mechs and 5 Enemy AI mechs that actively pathfind around obstacles, capture beacons, use their signature abilities, and retreat behind cover when low on HP.
Respawn System: When destroyed, allow the player to select another mech from their hangar to drop back into the arena until either team hits 100 Control Points or wipes out the enemy roster.
4. Controls, Visuals @COMMENT_BODY@ Game Juice:
Controls: WASD to drive the lower mech legs/chassis, Mouse to rotate the upper torso/turret independently, Left-Click to fire both mounted weapons (with separate reload meters around the cursor), Q and E to fire Left/Right mounts individually, and Spacebar to activate the Mech's Signature Ability.
Visual Polish: Distinct leg movement vs. upper-turret rotation, neon muzzle flashes, floating damage numbers, announcer banners (Double Elimination, Zone Dominated, Godlike), screen shake on critical hits, and a sleek HUD showing Team Scores, Beacon statuses, and Ability Cooldowns.
Deliver the full, complete, un-truncated code in a single .html block.\" (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
